title: Type-safe errors and Result patterns
description: Secure type-safe errors and result patterns boundaries through runtime validation, typed results and local TypeScript tests rather than trusting erased annotations.
objectives: Distinguish static typing from runtime trust in type-safe errors and result patterns
Validate unknown input or normalize transport data before constructing a domain value
Verify rejected and accepted cases with runnable tests plus compiler checks
rubric: I can identify the untrusted runtime boundary in type-safe errors and result patterns.
I reject at least one malformed input and validate one successful case.
I avoid unchecked type assertions in public API contracts.
